No. 55/1/1/71-CP
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
CABINET SECRETARIAT
(Department of Cabinet Affairs)

New Delhi, the 3rd May 1971,
13th Vaisakha 1893.
---

The undersigned is directed to state that with effect
from the afternoon of May 2, 1971,

1. Shri Uma Shankar Dikshit assumed the office of Minister
 of Works and Housing;

2. Shri H.N. Bahuguna assumed the office of Minister (of
 State) of Communications;

3. Prof. D.P. Chattopadhyaya assumed the office of Minister
 of State in the Ministry of Health and Family Planning;

4. Shri Hiti Raj Singh Chaudhury relinquished the office of
 Minister of State in the Ministry of Petroleum, Chemicals
 and Non-Ferrous Metals and assumed the office of Minister
 of State in the Ministry of Law and Justice;

5. Shri D.R. Chavan relinquished the office of Minister of
 State in the Ministry of Petroleum, Chemicals and Non-
 Ferrous Metals and assumed the office of Minister(of State)
 of Supply;

6. Shri Mohan Dharia assumed the office of Minister of
 State in the Ministry of Planning;

8. Shri I.K. Gujral relinquished the office of Minister of
 Works, Housing and Urban Development and assumed the
 office of Minister of State in the Ministry of Works and
 Housing;

9. Shri Shah Nawaz Khan assumed the office of Minister of
 State in the Ministry of Steel and Mines;

10. Dr. (Smt) Sarojini Mahishi relinquished the office of
 Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Tourism & Civil
 Aviation and assumed the office of Minister of State in
 the Ministry of Tourism & Civil Aviation;

11. Shri Ghanshyam Bhat Oza assumed the office of Minister
 of State in the Ministry of Industrial Development;

12. Shri Prakashchand B. Sethi relinquished the office of
 Minister of State (Defence Production) in the Ministry of
 Defence and assumed the office of Minister of Petroleum
 and Chemicals;

13. Shri V.C. Shukla relinquished the office of Minister of
 State in the Ministry of Finance and assumed the office
 of Minister of State (Defence Production) in the Ministry
 of Defence;
